title: Secondary prep chip position
description: The 'Prepare your secondary' chip and prepare banner, before and after anchoring them in the board's own toolbar strip and board column, at 1280x720, 1440x900, 1024x768 and 390x844.

shots.heading: Waiting: the Prepare chip at 1280x720, before
shots.caption: Base commit: the chip is positioned from the viewport-relative toolbar bottom inside a container that starts at the top of the app, so it lands header-height too low and covers the top tile row (on a phone it covers the turn banner and the Technologies/Objectives row).

shots.heading: Waiting: the Prepare chip at 1280x720, after
shots.caption: The chip is a row of the board's own toolbar strip: the map is fitted below it, so it cannot cover the toolbar, the seat legend, the header or a tile. The capture script asserts that.

shots.heading: Prepare panel open at 1280x720, before
shots.caption: Base commit: the banner is offset by the same wrong amount.

shots.heading: Prepare panel open at 1280x720, after
shots.caption: The banner floats directly below the toolbar strip, measured from the board column's own top (no viewport math); on a phone it docks at the bottom as before, above the Players/Events buttons. The strip keeps the chip's height, so the map does not jump.

shots.heading: Prepared at 1280x720, before
shots.caption: Base commit: the Prepared chip sits at the same wrong offset, over the top tiles.

shots.heading: Prepared at 1280x720, after
shots.caption: Same slot, with the Prepared badge and Clear prepared; asserted clear of toolbar, legend, header and top tile row.

notes.title: Before shots
notes.text: Captured on the base commit (unified-2026-10-08) with TI4_SHOT_PREFIX=before and committed as PNGs; npm run screenshots -- AN regenerates the after-* shots and asserts the chip is clear of the toolbar, the seat legend, the header and the top tile row.

notes.title: Approach
notes.text: The chip is portaled into a slot in .board-chrome (flow item, no coordinates). The banner and bars are mounted in the board column and positioned from --board-chrome-bottom, now measured relative to that column and refreshed by a ResizeObserver on the strip and the column plus window resize.
